result_text:
I changed the standard conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` tests pass (330 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped). I didn't add tests for the new rules, so the new patterns themselves haven't been run against sample paths.

- **Hidden files rule:** I replaced the "Hidden files and folders" rule with `(.*/)?[.](git|svn|hg|bzr)/.*`. Only contents of those version-control folders are ignored, at any depth and also for paths that start with `.git/`. Plain dotfiles and other dotted folders, such as `src/.config/Foo.java`, are no longer ignored.
- **Build-and-deployment scope:** I added `(.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.*` as the first build-and-deployment convention.
- **`dependencies`:** I removed the ignore rule for `dependencies` folders.

All other ignore rules, including `.yarn/releases`, `.yarn/plugins`, `node_modules` and `vendor`, are unchanged.
